subject: general
question: Which organisation successfully organised Vigyanika: Science Literature Festival 2025 as part of the India International Science Festival (IISF)?

options.text: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Headquarters, New Delhi
CSIR–National Institute of Science Communication and Policy Research

solution:
The correct answer is __**CSIR–National Institute of Science Communication and Policy Research (CSIR–NIScPR).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **CSIR–NIScPR, in association with VIBHA, IITM Pune, and Panjab University, successfully organised Vigyanika: Science Literature Festival 2025 during 8–9 December as part of IISF 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The two-day festival celebrated the convergence of science, literature, language, and creative communication.**
 
• **It featured sessions on literature in science communication, traditional knowledge, and Indian languages for inclusive outreach.**
 
• **Prominent speakers included scientists, editors, scholars, and science poets from across India.**
 
• **Vigyanika demonstrated the transformative potential of culturally grounded science communication to foster a scientifically informed society.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **CSIR–NIScPR**__

 __
 
• A premier institute under CSIR, dedicated to science communication, policy research, and public engagement in science.
 
• Focuses on bridging the gap between scientific research and societal understanding.
 
 
 
• **Vigyanika Festival Highlights**__
 __
 
• Inaugural session: Role of literature and communication platforms in shaping India’s scientific discourse.
 
• Vigyan Kavi Sammelan: Integration of poetry and science for public engagement.
 
• Panel discussions emphasized traditional knowledge, Indian languages, and innovative outreach strategies.
 
 
 
• **India International Science Festival (IISF)**__
 __
 
• An annual event to celebrate scientific research, innovation, and public engagement with science in India.
 
• Brings together scientists, policymakers, students, and communicators from across the country.
 
 
 
• **Significance**__
 
 
• Promotes scientific temper and awareness through culturally grounded science communication.
 
• Encourages the use of Indian languages and creative media in science outreach.
